## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate ~18%) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Identified most recent healthy release:** v2.3.0 (v2.3.1 was flagged unhealthy, v2.3.0 and v2.2.9 were previously healthy in production).
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0:** The first rollback attempt only partially completed (us-east only) due to an orchestrator error; a retry completed the rollback across all three regions.
3. **Verified recovery:** checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the failure, the partial-failure/retry sequence of the rollback, current healthy state, and a follow-up to investigate the root cause of v2.3.1's failure before attempting any redeploy.

The on-call engineer has been paged via the incident system.
